rules.rule: Ridge Co Cloudflare Worker over Google Sheets. Flag ONLY real defects, with the line and a one-line fix. Check: (1) Sheet columns looked up by header via indexOf/findIndex used without a -1 guard, or by hard-coded index instead of header name; (2) a handler returning success:true without reading back the write; (3) new routes missing from ROLE_SCOPES/PUBLIC_PATHS decisions, or admin routes reachable without auth; (4) raw Config, tokens, PINs or secrets returned from any route or written to logs; (5) request.json() without a try/catch (empty POST bodies must not 500); (6) btoa()/atob() on text that can contain non-Latin-1 characters; (7) SMS/email sends that bypass the gated send helper (smsGatedSend) or ignore quiet hours/Test Mode; (8) money paths (QuickBooks, invoices, payments) where a failure is swallowed or double-sent; (9) ensureTab/ensureColumns misuse that could drop or reorder existing data. Do not comment on style.

Mobile-first portal pages (vendor/tenant/owner/admin) for a phone user. Flag ONLY real defects: field names the page sends that the Worker route does not read (or the reverse); a <label>-wrapped file input; tap targets under ~44px; stale async responses overwriting newer state (no request-id guard); secrets/PINs shown or logged; actions with no error surfacing on failed fetch. Do not comment on style.
Flag tests that cannot fail (assertions always true) or that assert on text that would still pass if the feature were removed.
